director.summary: Deterministic demo direction: alternate explanation, callout, and architecture. This is a mock, not AI analysis.

scenes.narration: You have two servers. Two copies of the database. Maybe even two regions. Then one ordinary deployment takes everything down. The architecture was redundant. The service was not available.
scenes.rationale: Let the presenter carry the thought.

scenes.narration: Redundancy describes the parts you own. Availability describes what a user can actually do. Adding another copy only helps when the failure that breaks one copy leaves the other useful.

parameters.title: Two copies. One failure domain.
parameters.subtitle: Design for recovery, then prove it.

scenes.rationale: Make the dependency or decision visible.

scenes.narration: Imagine two application servers behind a load balancer. Both depend on one database endpoint. When that shared dependency fails, the second application server is just another machine returning the same error.

visual.description: A shared dependency can break both.

parameters.title: A shared dependency can break both.
parameters.subtitle: Redundant servers still depend on the same database.

scenes.rationale: Make the dependency or decision visible.

scenes.narration: Even independent copies are not enough. Something must detect the failure, route traffic, and preserve the information needed to continue. A standby that nobody can reach is capacity, not recovery.
scenes.rationale: Let the presenter carry the thought.

scenes.narration: So test the entire path. Break a dependency. Watch detection. Measure the switch. Check a real request. Include the control plane, credentials, and the people who have to make the decision.

visual.description: Failover is a path you must test.

parameters.title: Failover is a path you must test.
parameters.subtitle: Detect → route → serve → verify

scenes.rationale: Make the dependency or decision visible.

scenes.narration: The useful question is not, how many copies do we have? It is, what happens to the next user request when this part fails? Availability is a behavior. Build it, then prove it.

parameters.title: Availability is a behavior.
parameters.subtitle: Design for recovery, then prove it.
